I would never bring my dog here again.
First, she came back with a completely uneven haircut. She had small cuts in multiple places, and the area around her private parts was shaved dangerously short, down to the pink skin, which is completely unnecessary and concerning.

To be fair, she was a bit matted but this isn’t the first time that’s happened. On a previous occasion with a different groomer, she was matted as well, yet she was returned to me with an even haircut and zero cuts or injuries. If you don’t know how to properly groom matted hair, that’s okay, but be honest about your skill set instead of risking a dog’s safety.

But the biggest issue happened the day after her grooming appointment. I noticed she was struggling to keep her left eye open. It was swollen, watery, and she was clearly in pain, crying often. I rushed her to the vet, where I was told she had an ulcer — for those unfamiliar, that’s essentially a cut on the eye. Nearly $300 later, plus a week of medication and wearing a cone, she’s finally okay — but this should have never happened.

For context, my dog is almost two years old and has been groomed every two months since she was a puppy. She’s been to three different groomers before this one, and not once has anyone mentioned her being difficult. In fact, I’ve received compliments on how easy she is to work with.

So I’m honestly just confused and upset. I don’t understand how all of this happened during one visit. Safe to say I won’t be bringing her here ever again.

I did not initially express my dissatisfaction with the fact my instructions were to keep the ears long on my female and you cut them short, I asked for round faces and you cut that wrong as well their faces were cut too short for round on both dogs. I found you on my own and  gave you a try based on how conveniently close to my home you are. The reason I did not express dissatisfaction is because I was too upset with how my dog responded to me, how he ran to me frantically as if he were afraid of and running from you, Josh, when I came to pick him up. I avoid being confrontational when angry especially knowing I would never bring them back to your establishment. People, please be careful with this groomer. Make sure to examine your pets after having them groomed at this establishment since they cannot tell you what happened during the groom. Better yet if at all possible, stay for the groom and observe. I wish I had. Not saying Josh was not nice but I missed the first red flag when he greeted my dogs as if he were not sure as a handler,  and looking back, their response to meeting him was off since they normally take to people very well, especially my male pup, but I regretfully missed it at that time. I have no reason to lie about my experience, or on this groomer but like I stated in my initial review,  upon examining my dogs their necks were swollen. You should be happy I only posted this review to warn other dog owners rather than reporting you to the police. Take heed how you handle people's dogs moving forward but don't imply I'm a liar or delusional regarding my own dogs when you were still paid. How dare you! Just call me and offer me an apology or even a full refund for my legitimate review. I chose to take the high road about the situation instead of  confronting you.  You have my number.
Please be careful with having your dogs groomed here. You see how cold the AI generated response is. They will not be accountable. This is a warning to all dog owners considering this establishment for grooming. Consider yourselves warned. And this is not AI generated.
